overview: In each episode, employees from offices across the country will showcase their vocal talents. The winner will be determined by audience vote.
title: Поющий офис

overview: The series takes place in a "backwater" police station in a certain metropolis. The station is held in low regard by its superiors and, consequently, serves as a place of exile for all offending police officers. The series' protagonists are the station's employees. The plot revolves around their relationships and the events of their professional and personal lives.
title: Однажды в милиции

overview: Farm owner and restaurateur Matt Baumgartner, an accomplished but demanding entrepreneur, who runs the farm, restaurant/bar and events space with the help of a team of well-intentioned 20-somethings who aren't always on the same page as their detail-obsessed boss. Matt Baumgartner, owner of June Farms, wants to make it the premiere event space in the Hudson Valley. He has his hands full every week delivering perfect bespoke weddings. With a young, vibrant staff of varying personalities, at times more focused on their love lives than their jobs and inclement weather, this wedding season turned out to be the hardest one in June Farms' history.
title: June Farms

overview: It seems like an accidental encounter in a bar, but Qin Yu Lin, the driver of Xingyao Group, lies in the bed of Xu En Xin, the daughter of Fenghua Chamber of Commerce. Xu En Xin is deeply attracted to Qin Yu Lin and asks Zhou Xing Han, the president of Xingyao Group, for him, so he becomes her exclusive driver. He will silently remember all her preferences, will hand her just the right amount of coffee when she is tired, and will be the first to stand in front of her when danger comes. Xu En Xin gradually finds that she is becoming more and more dependent on this driver.
title: Dark Light

overview: Li Sui An, a peasant girl from Honggu Village, has no parents and wants to find a husband to live a stable life. However, she has been on many blind dates and has been frustrated by the frequent appearance of bad men. Until a new neighbor appears, he has a thin waist, long legs, and is extremely handsome. Li Sui An is attracted to him at first sight and decides to marry him home, letting him take care of his beauty while she takes care of earning money to support the family.
title: Summer Waves and You

overview: Pit Bulls & Parolees follows the turbulent drama and bittersweet moments as ex-convicts and ill-reputed dogs come together to strengthen one another. Sharing the same dominant traits of a pit bull -- determination, agility, strength and energy -- Torres has the power to make a positive change for the prison community and the dog world. Watch as one woman pulls the weight of 1,000 men to fulfill her dream of saving pit bulls from dangerous situations and giving parolees a chance to repair their reputations and their lives.
title: Pit Bulls & Parolees

overview: The ACC Football Championship Game, also known as the Dr. Pepper ACC Football Championship Game is an American college football game held on the first Saturday in December by the Atlantic Coast Conference (ACC) each year to determine its football champion. The game pits the champion of the Coastal Division against the champion of the Atlantic Division in a game that follows the conclusion of the regular season. The game's corporate sponsor is Dr. Pepper.
title: ACC Football Championship Game

overview: Jiang Yu grew up in Yangcheng, a city with continuous rain all year round. She inherited all her grandfather's inheritance, but was locked up in a wooden building by the Song family, pretending to be crazy and living a miserable life, leaving her to rot on her own. In order to seek revenge, she left the old house and set her sights on He Lian, the prince of Jinzhou, and set up a trap for him.
title: Guai Guai Ru Ju, He Shao Fang Si Jiao Chong

overview: Su Ke Ke and her mother run a snack bar. Ke Ke is engaged to Qiao Yu Fan, an employee of the Pei Group. During a meal delivery, she witnesses Yu Fan cheating on her with the Pei Group executive Jiang Xiao Yuan. Drowning her sorrows at night, she runs into Pei Yan, Pei Group's CEO, who is framed by his brother Pei Yu because of the fight for inheritance. However, Yan loses his memory after waking up, and his temperament changes drastically. Su Ke Ke names Yan "Lucky." Because Ke Ke's mother is seriously ill, she wants to find a husband for Ke Ke. So, Ke Ke and Yan have a sudden marriage.
title: Accidental Noble Husband

overview: Yu Tian Dong, who suffers from various mental illnesses, falls in love with his psychological counselor, Nan Xing. The ten months they spend together are extremely agonizing for Xing. After leaving Tian Dong in a cruel manner, Xing is always uneasy about whether he will take revenge, but he disappears for two years. Just when she thinks she has completely gotten rid of him, he reappears on her wedding day and kidnaps her husband, Su Mu, to threaten her into a divorce. For Mu's safety, she has no choice but to be in Tian Dong's clutches again. From then on, she has only one goal in life: to get rid of Tian Dong for good, even if it means she has to escape to outer space. When Xing finally comes up with a way to be rid of Tian Dong completely, she realizes that she has become more dependent on him than she thinks...
title: Helpless without You

overview: As a nanny, Gu Ci only did two things around Jiang Qi Yun, to please him and to please his son. In daily life, Jiang Qi Yun found that Gu Ci's smiles and frowns gradually overlapped with the girl in his memory, and the past slowly emerged.
title: How Can We Resist Her Charm

overview: One is anxious and eager for life-saving money; the other is ambitious and frantically needs to be promoted. And so a deal was born. She was originally just a pawn, but during the transaction, the two couldn't help but fall in love with each other...
title: Debauchery

overview: The location of this fiction reality comedy is Japan and Thailand. Four not too young, legendary actor - Sándor Badár, Imre Csuja, Attila Epres and Péter Scherer - and their loyal "weapon bearer", the famous hairdresser Fecó Frohner would like to prove that openness, curiosity and the love of life are not depend on your age.
title: Jobb később, mint soha!

overview: Elite athletes from eight countries battle for national pride. After grueling tests of raw strength and endurance, only one flag can claim victory.
title: Physical: Asia

overview: The Pacific-12 Football Championship Game is a college football game currently held by the Pacific-12 Conference (Pac-12) each year to determine the conference's season champion. The inaugural game was held December 2, 2011, at 8:00 pm ET/5:00 pm PT. The game pits the champion of the Pac-12 North (California, Oregon, Oregon State, Stanford, Washington, Washington State) against the champion of the Pac-12 South (Arizona, Arizona State, Colorado, UCLA, USC, and Utah). As of 2014, the game is played at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, California. Prior to that the game was played at the home stadium of the division winner with the better conference record, with Autzen Stadium, Stanford Stadium, and Sun Devil Stadium each hosting one of the three games.
title: Pacific-12 Football Championship Game

overview: After her sailor fiancé is wrongly imprisoned in 1815 Marseille, a determined woman's rescue attempt ends in tragedy, leading her down a path of vengeance against powerful conspirators.
title: La Comtesse de Monte-Cristo

overview: The plot centres on the Romanchuk family, typical Ukrainians with their weaknesses and habits. The head of the family spent twenty years working in Italy and now returns home with a decision: Sunday dinners must become mandatory for all family members. He is confident that these gatherings will help revive family ties and restore lost warmth. However, in practice, these dinners turn into not peaceful conversations, but real comedic battles with many curious situations, misunderstandings, and unexpected confessions.
title: Сімʼя по неділях

overview: Four strangers meet at the funeral of a woman they all once dated — a soldier who died on the front line. She invited them to be there, but why? At her favorite bar, their stories about her slowly shift into stories about themselves.
title: Ховаючи колишню

overview: Siblings Daisy May and Charlie Cooper sleep over at the UK's spookiest places... hopefully alone. What secrets will emerge and will they still be talking to each other by dawn?
title: Daisy May & Charlie Cooper's Nightwatch

overview: A behind-the-scenes look at how discount disruptors are leading the charge in the bargain revolution. How are they saving us money and bagging such good deals?
title: Secrets of Supercheap Shopping

overview: Artyom, an IT specialist, accidentally becomes the owner of a magical artifact and discovers a different Moscow, where powerful sorcerers and magicians live hiding from human eyes. This alternative capital is governed by three Great Houses: Nav, Chud and After All. Artyom finds himself in the very center of their confrontation, as a result of which his life changes forever.
title: Тайный город

overview: The series is about today's life, transferred to the scenery of the XIII century. Here, instead of fabulous antiquity, there are witty anachronisms: a "beauty camp" with "lip stinging" procedures operates in the village, horses are "understated" and given "cast" horseshoes, and the cellular connection is replaced by "Vestilo" — children who carry the news.
title: Очень древняя Русь

overview: The brutal Russian cop Vasya lives by his own concepts and does not recognize technology. However, fate brings him together with the artificial intelligence svt 1,9, or simply Sveta. Vasya tries to get rid of the imposed "partner", but eventually realizes that Sveta not only helps him solve crimes, but also gives him a chance to figure out his own life. An unusual couple investigates new cases, encountering curiosities, conflicts and unexpected discoveries.
title: Нейровася

overview: Nadia, a chef with thirty years of experience, runs a cozy dining room next to the police station. Her son, Pasha, works as an operative and helps his mother with business — police officers often come to her for a bite of homemade food. One day, the police find out that an influential businessman is looking for a new personal chef — and this is a chance to get as close to him as possible. To help her son and his colleagues solve the case, Nadia decides to infiltrate the suspect's house, disguised as a cook, and find herself in the very center of events.
title: Повар под прикрытием

overview: Major Elizabeth Kiver, is coming to the city of Krasnov. Krasnovsky district has long lost a strong hand: the operas are lazy and cynical, the duty officer sleeps on duty, and the detection statistics are flying into the abyss. But Elizabeth Kiver is a charismatic, strong—willed, but vulnerable woman who never gives up and knows how to hold a punch, even if the whole world is against her. From the very first days, Lisa understands that her subordinates are a special category of people: opera Colban, who is in eternal conflict with sobriety, Maxim is a cunning man and a lover of "earning extra money" in any way, and Vanya is a romantic dog driver without a dog. Together they become a source of endless catastrophes, ridiculous situations and poignant moments, but gradually it is this motley team that begins to become a family.
title: Гуляй, шальная!

overview: To celebrate 30 years of the soap, Hollyoaks stars Isabelle Smith, Anya Lawrence, Charlie Wernham, James Redmond and Nicole Barber-Lane take it in turns to throw a dinner party.
title: Hollyoaks Does Come Dine With Me

overview: An investigation into a viral prison sex tape leads journalist Mobeen Azhar to discover an illicit prison economy fuelled by inappropriate relationships, coercion and contraband.
title: Behind Bars: Sex, Bribes and Murder

overview: Happy birthday! Mary Berry is joined by famous friends to share memories and recipes. Celebrating the joy of food, they'll revisit old favourites and discover new delicious dishes.
title: Mary at 90: A Lifetime of Cooking

overview: The Army-Navy Game is an American college football rivalry game between the teams of the United States Military Academy (USMA) at West Point, New York and the United States Naval Academy (USNA) at Annapolis, Maryland. The USMA team, the "Army Black Knights", and the USNA team, the "Navy Midshipmen", each represent their services' oldest officer commissioning sources. As such, the game has come to embody the spirit of the interservice rivalry of the United States Armed Forces. The game marks the end of the college football regular season and the third and final game of the season's Commander-in-Chief's Trophy, which includes the Falcons of the U.S. Air Force Academy. The Army-Navy Game is one of the most traditional and enduring rivalries in college football. The game is nationally televised by CBS, which has aired the game every year since 1984 except for a five-year stint on ABC from 1991–1995. Instant replay made its American debut in the 1963 Army-Navy game. The winner of the game is awarded the Thompson Cup, named after its donor, Robert M. Thompson. The most recent game (the 115th) in the series was held at M&T Bank Stadium in Maryland, on December 13, 2014. Navy won the game by a score of 17–10. Navy leads the all-time series with a record of 59 wins, 49 losses, and seven ties.
title: Army-Navy Game

overview: `Hollyoaks Later' is a spinoff of long-running soap opera `Hollyoaks'. The programme, which airs in a late-night time slot, delves deeper into the lives, loves and misdemeanours of some of the `Hollyoaks' characters, who shed their teen images as they try to find their feet away from the village. Due to its late-night schedule, `Hollyoaks Later' offers raunchier storylines and events than its parent programme, which airs earlier in the day.
title: Hollyoaks Later

overview: Near the courier station lies the Lohas Inn, a place that secretly gathers intelligence. The innkeeper, Tian Jinjin, is clever, alert, and kind-hearted; the waiter, Tian Dazhuang, is skilled in martial arts; the musician, Piao Daoyi, is knowledgeable and worldly; and the accountant, Madam Tian, has sharp eyes and an excellent memory. Each of the four harbors their own secrets, yet fate has brought them together. The high-spirited General Fu, demoted to the Central Post Station after offending a powerful noble, is in fact there to investigate a major case. Just as feelings begin to grow between him and Jinjin, an urgent border dispatch goes missing, and the courier is found murdered—plunging the entire city into turmoil.
title: Food For Lucking

overview: There's an old myth that haunts the seemingly perfect small town of Roosevelt: if you have sex too young, you'll contract the "bug," a virus that literally turns you into a "monster" from your worst nightmares. Absurd, right? That's what Chris always assumed, until, after one reckless night at the beginning of senior year, she finds herself infected. Now she'll be cast out to the woods to live with the other infected, where a chilling, new threat emerges: a serial killer who's hunting them one-by-one.
title: Black Hole
Shan Hun Tian Qi Jing Neng Gei Zong Cai Xu Ming

overview: Food Network's All-Star Specials showcase festivals to holiday meals with your favorite Food Network hosts and chefs, there's always something new to tempt your tastebuds.
title: Food Network's All-Star Specials

overview: Military Police at Fort Stewart defend the gate with hilarious authority..
title: Checkpoint Charlie

overview: What would make a loving mother, and a faithful wife turn to a life of crime? Find out in this moving drama as Alani navigates through love, loss, and poverty.
title: Cocaine Sisters

overview: Modern Marvels: WWII marks the return of the acclaimed franchise that has long celebrated the ingenuity, creativity, and engineering feats that surround us every day. This new limited series event expands the franchise's legacy, spotlighting the innovations that defined an era and changed the course of history. It will explore the greatest machines, most impactful weapons, and groundbreaking innovations of WWII, shining a light on the engineering and technological advances that shaped the course of the conflict and continue to influence our world today.
title: Modern Marvels: WWII

overview: CÓMPLICES follows María José, Paula, Roberta, and Stacy four women working behind the scenes of a daytime talk show. Their lives take an unexpected turn when the show's producer, a man who has tormented them for years, is found dead. Suddenly, they become suspects in this crime. Though they maintain their innocence, this unforeseen situation becomes the spark that bonds them, inspiring them to rediscover themselves and embrace life with newfound freedom and humor. The irreverent and empowering comedy doubles as a story of liberation, symbolically burying their past traumas and insecurities as they become true accomplices in their pursuit of happiness, love and fulfillment.
title: Cómplices

overview: After her parents are murdered by bandits posing as Imperial Guards, Dai Qingyin infiltrates the palace disguised as the courtesan Hongxiu to seek revenge. There, she falls for Xiao Yanhe—an emperor hiding his identity—and together they try to uncover true mastermind behind a royal conspiracy.
title: Beauty's Bone, Scarlet Sleeves
Switched Souls: The General's New Style

overview: The Story Is will feature live nightly panels and debates on set featuring a range of voices including attorneys Gloria Allred and Areva Martin, conservative talk radio hosts Larry Elder and Jennifer Horn, progressive podcast host Brian Tyler Cohen, former California GOP chair Jessica Millan Patterson and journalists Peter Hamby from Puck and POLITICO's Melanie Mason.
title: The Story Is with Elex Michaelson
A Journey of Promise and Remembrance

overview: Ahora 360 will feature social, political and cultural stories along with dynamic conversations with newsmakers, thought leaders and personalities discussing a diverse range of issues impacting the Latino community.
title: Ahora 360

overview: The fears and dreams of teenagers caught between ambition and reality. Using the app is simple: upload a video of your wish and wait for it to come true — at a cost. What shocking truths will they uncover as they grapple with the consequences of their wishes?
title: If Wishes Could Kill

overview: Kingdom will dramatically chronicle the real-life sagas of four African animal families, in one of the most ambitious projects ever undertaken by the BBC Studios Natural History Unit. Filmed across five years in a single spectacular location, the lives and fates of our four families – leopards, hyenas, wild dogs and lions – are inextricably linked as they strive for a foothold in a remote and fertile river valley in Zambia. As well as the intense power struggles between these top predators, the series shows how a colourful supporting cast, from powerful elephant herds to vast flocks of crimson bee-eaters to troops of marauding baboons, impact our central characters in surprising and diverse ways.
title: Kingdom
Please Take Care of My Refrigerator

overview: In each episode, the hosts, along with viewers and invited guests—influencers and medical experts—explore a specific health topic in a confidential atmosphere, drawing on the most popular search queries among young people and the common myths associated with them.
title: Доктор, у меня это

overview: The travel show "Where They Filmed" explores the locations of famous Russian films and TV series and uncovers interesting facts about the filming process at these locations.
title: Где снимали?

overview: A new project by the Foundation for the Development of Scientific and Cultural Relations, "Challenge," is a journey into the world of ideas, where complex theories and the language of art take on new forms. Author and host Sofiko Shevardnadze invites outstanding scientists and renowned actors, directors, musicians, dancers, and theater critics to reflect on the present, past, and future. Together, the project's protagonists seek unexpected points of contact between significant discoveries and creative processes, while viewers get the chance to see our reality from a new perspective.
title: Вызов Софико

overview: Million-following bloggers became laborers at the Valaam Monastery. They learned to work, pray, communicate with the monks, faced daily challenges, and overcame themselves.
title: Монастыринг

overview: A terrible storm is raging the night it all begins with a knock on the door. 17-year-old Jim Hawkins helps his widowed mother run their little tavern on the coast of 19th-century England. When the door is opened they are startled by a sight that makes their blood run cold. The figure standing there is covered in scars and has a strange, insane glint in his eye. In the days that follow the grizzled old sailor, Bill Bones, spends hours on end staring out to sea until the day a crazed blind man at the head of a murderous gang of pirates tracks down Bill Bones--and murders him. All for a scrap of paper, Jim discovers to his amazement, but this scrap of paper is a map marking the location of fabulous buried treasure--gold, silver and jewels saved over the years by the ruthless, highly successful pirate, Captain Flint. It is hidden on a distant, mysterious island--and Jim manages to escape the furious pirates with the map. Now the prospect of finding such fantastic wealth exerts a magic spell on all and sundry. Soon Jim is part of an expedition alongside long-legged Long John Silver to find the treasure. At first the sea journey is an unfamiliar new adventure for Jim although he is fascinated by the charismatic Long John Silver. He quickly discovers that the crew Silver recruited is made up of fierce pirates--rough-and-ready brutal bandits who have sailed the seven seas in search of booty. The motley crew also includes 17-year-old Sheila, disguised as a ship's boy. The pretty young girl is pursuing the treasure for her own reasons: as Captain Flint's daughter, she believes that she alone is entitled to it, and she is prepared to go to any lengths to get the loot. But Jim Hawkins knows all too well that her life is worthless if Long John Silver and his men should discover her. As the Hispaniola sails on towards Treasure Island, Jim tries to gain Sheila's trust--to help her find the traces of her deceased father's life in the buried treasure. Thus the thrilling adventure begins, and Jim is exposed to a range of terrible ordeals--starting with mutiny. When our heroes finally reach the mysterious island, they find ample evidence of Captain Flint's gruesome deeds, including a crazed shipmate who was abandoned there years ago and is now intent on violent revenge. As the tale of treachery and pirate treasure unfolds, Jim is forced to grow up quickly--or die. As he survives thrilling adventures by the skin of his teeth, his experiences help him become a man. But will he find the treasure? Will Sheila obtain her inheritance? And how many of them will leave Treasure Island alive?
title: Die Schatzinsel

overview: Seven News live coverage of local, national and international news, plus sport, finance and weather updates.
title: Seven Noon News

overview: This series chronicles the lives of Rome's greatest gladiators - from Spartacus's defiant rebellion to Flamma's ultimate sacrifice in the arena. Their stories reveal the brutal rise and fall of gladiatorial combat, exposing how bloodsport shaped Roman power, culture, and identity. Through rebellion, spectacle, and survival, these warriors became legends in an empire built on violence and glory.
title: Gladiators: Warriors of the Ancient World

overview: From award-winning director Caveh Zahedi, The Show About The Show is his self-referential scripted metaseries about a Brooklyn filmmaker trying to make a TV show. Co-starring Alex Karpovsky, Eleonore Hendricks, Dustin Defa and a who's who of Brooklyn's independent filmmaking community, the show tells the story of everything that can and does go wrong as Caveh tries to get a television series funded, produced, and distributed.
title: The Show About the Show

overview: A gripping true-crime docuseries that follows a modern romance that spiraled into a dangerous game of deception. When Amber starts dating Brandon after meeting him online, he seems like the perfect boyfriend. But when she connects with his ex-wife, Athena, everything is turned upside-down as they learn the truth together: Brandon is a manipulative liar with dark secrets.
title: Don't Date Brandon

overview: A single mother — and luxury bag counterfeiter — finds herself teaming up with a self-obsessed influencer to sell her bags and scrape her way out of debt.
title: Bad Influencer

overview: Scholar Xie Yuan wanders into a matriarchal kingdom where polyandry is practiced. His striking looks catch the eye of the Eldest Princess, who forcibly takes him to her palace to become her male consort. Refusing to submit, Xie Yuan plots his escape. On his flight, he encounters the seemingly kind and beautiful Second Princess, who offers help. What appears to be a chance meeting soon drags him into a web of courtly intrigue...
title: Her Phoenix Majesty
I Loved You in My Dreams

overview: The Rocky Mountain Mortician Murder exposes the disturbing truths that can lurk just beneath the surface of seemingly friendly communities. Featuring interviews with key individuals involved in the case, the investigators who searched for the truth, and the townspeople who still wrestle with the revelations this investigation exposed, this docuseries shows that no matter how hard people try to keep their secrets hidden, the truth has a way of always coming to light. In October 2012, Byron Griffy—respected mortician, devoted family man, and pillar of his rural Colorado community—was found dead on his remote ranch, shot execution-style. At first glance, it looked like a robbery gone wrong. But as detectives dug deeper, they discovered something far more twisted: an unthinkable betrayal and a tangled web of lies that exposed the town's darkest secrets.
title: The Rocky Mountain Mortician Murder

overview: Two Yoo Project – Sugar Man is a 2015 South Korean television program starring various artists. The original 2-episode pilot aired at 22:50 (KST) on Wednesday (August 19 & 26, 2015) under the name Two Yoo Project Searching For Sugar Man. The regular broadcast of Season 1, hosted by Yoo Jae Suk, You Hee Yeol, Kim Eana and Sandara Park, kicked off beginning October 20, 2015, every Tuesday at 22:50 (KST), ended on July 12, 2016. Season 2 airs starting January 14, 2018, every Sunday at 22:40 (KST). Park Na Rae and Joy (Red Velvet) join as MCs alongside Yoo Jae Suk and You Hee Yeol.
title: Two Yoo Project: Sugar Man

overview: Join Fox News' Bret Baier for exclusive interviews on what's happening inside the Beltway and on the world stage.
title: A Bret Baier Interview

overview: From dark matter to black holes, stellar explosions to the absence of alien life, this mind-bending series will explore some of the universe's greatest enigmas.
title: Into the Universe: Mysteries of the Cosmos

overview: Comedy program about fictional cases surrounding Norwegian celebs.
title: Retten er satt

overview: The daughter of a powerful police officer has dodged assassination attempts and is now secretly in an elite training program. There, she meets a disciplined officer with sharp instincts. They're forced to share a room, and their chemistry starts to change. But political conspiracies, a hidden murder, and a complicated past threaten to tear them apart. When one finds out that the other's father might be connected to her own family's tragedy, their feelings are tested by duty, danger, and the cost of truth. They have to choose between justice and the love they never knew they had.
title: Heart Code

overview: "Caroline Flack: Search for the Truth" examines the shocking story of Caroline Flack, "Love Island" presenter and one of Britain's biggest stars. After her arrest in 2019, she became the target of a relentless media storm. Vilified in the press and online, her world spiraled – ending in tragedy when she took her own life. This powerful two-part documentary follows Caroline's mother, Christine, as she investigates the truth about her daughter's final months – uncovering new shocking details, asking difficult questions, and exposing the misrepresentations, pressures, and failures from institutions and decision makers that shaped Caroline's final days. With access to powerful testimony from Caroline's inner circle and those who were there, the series tells the story she never got to share and reveals an unprecedented look at what really happened to Caroline Flack.
title: Caroline Flack: Search for the Truth

overview: Hosted by renowned wildlife biologist, conservationist, and adventurer Forrest Galante, the six-episode series will take audiences on a visually stunning journey into Vantara, the world's largest wildlife rescue and rehabilitation facility that offers lifelong care for some of the most magnificent animals on Earth. Located in Gujarat, India, Vantara is a closed-to-the-public sanctuary designed for the wellbeing of the animals who live there. It is home to over one million animals, representing over 1000 species and is operated by a dedicated team of 25,000 employees. Now, for the first time ever, Galante offers an unprecedented look inside the walls of this extraordinary, not-for-profit sanctuary - a world very few have ever been allowed to enter.
title: Vantara: Sanctuary Stories
Koi wa Ameagari no You ni: Pocket no Naka no Negaigoto

overview: Guga por Kuerten chronicles Guga's rise to the top, from his humble beginnings and the early death of his father to becoming a global tennis legend.
title: Guga por Kuerten
Lee Soo Geun and Kim Byung Man's High Society

overview: David Rocco dives into trattorias, seaside markets, and back lane BBQs on an unapologetic journey through Italy where no bite is left behind.
title: David Rocco's Eating Dirty

overview: The show focuses on home makeovers that use bold colors and whimsical designs to create vibrant spaces. It follows Gray and her team as they surprise homeowners with dramatic renovations.
title: Anything But Gray

overview: Disguised as the top courtesan of a famed nightclub, assassin Zhen Xu crosses paths by chance with Zhou Musheng, a member of the North City Chamber of Commerce on a secret mission. What begins as mutual deception soon turns into genuine affection as they navigate a world filled with danger and betrayal. Facing life-and-death trials together, they ultimately join forces to expose the Chamber's illicit dealings, and find a new beginning amid the ruins.
title: Life Like

overview: After her artisan family is brutally massacred, Nan Yanzhi becomes the disciple of Zhuang Wujiu. Under her guidance, she transforms from an innocent young woman into a ruthless survivor willing to crawl through the mud for revenge. Clinging to the few clues left behind, she infiltrates the mysterious Lingya Tower alone. Rumor has it that everyone who enters the tower is turned into a beast in its deadly arena, and none ever make it out alive. Just as Nan Yanzhi believes she has no one to rely on, she discovers that Zhuang Wujiu has appeared within Lingya Tower—as one of its highest rulers.
title: Cage of Shadows

overview: Year 2047. Ecological collapse has led to the creation of FedSur, a coalition of South American countries that applies extreme measures to protect nature and counteract the prevailing hunger and violence. A new and captivating voice then emerges on the internet, a voice much more powerful than any other because it is capable of predicting the future. Police officer Hugo Crussí discovers that behind the voice is a young preacher named Jonás Flores, but his arrest causes him to become the spiritual leader of the continent overnight. Forecasting the fall of FedSur and victory over climate change, Jonás will make the Latin American people dream and will get many to join his reactionary revolution. Meanwhile, Crussí, pursued as a member of the resistance, will embark on a suicidal mission to end the tyrant, who will have foreseen the assassination and will be waiting for him.
title: El futuro es nuestro
